notablePrerequisites: Basal Thrull and Apprentice Necromancer do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Basal Thrull by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Apprentice Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping and sacrificing it, targeting Basal Thrull.
Ashnod triggers, copying Apprentice Necromancer's ability, targeting Apprentice Necromancer.
Resolve both Apprentice Necromancer abilities, returning Apprentice Necromancer and Basal Thrull from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving them haste until end of turn.
Repeat.
